label: WhatsApp
terms_note: Paid per delivered message (pricing analytics + a pricing page; no rate quoted on the docs pages opened); needs a business portfolio, a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) and a registered business phone number; business verification raises throughput / messaging tiers; template messages need Meta approval and are the ONLY type allowed outside the 24-hour customer-service window; user opt-in required before templates; default 80 messages/s per number, 1 message per 6 s to any single user; WhatsApp Management API 200 calls/h per app per WABA (5,000 for active accounts).

tools.name: publish_text
tools.endpoint: — (no feed; “status” updates are not in the Cloud API)

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.endpoint: messages with `context.message_id` (quote-reply to an inbound wamid)

tools.name: dm_send
tools.endpoint: POST /{phone_number_id}/messages (type=text|image|video|document|interactive inside the window; type=template outside)

tools.name: delete
tools.endpoint: — (a sent WhatsApp message cannot be deleted through the Cloud API)

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.endpoint: — (per-message delivery statuses arrive by webhook; no per-message analytics endpoint)

auth: 1. Meta business portfolio → **WhatsApp Business Account (WABA)** → registered business phone number (real or virtual;
2. System-user access token (or Embedded Signup OAuth for tenants) with `whatsapp_business_messaging` +
3. Webhook subscription on the app for `messages` (inbound + delivery statuses).
4. Business verification raises messaging tiers and throughput; Official Business Account badge is optional.

endpoints.purpose: templates are created / approved in WhatsApp Manager (or `POST /{waba_id}/message_templates`)
text, media, contacts; statuses sent / delivered / read

reference.limits: - **Paid** per delivered message (pricing page; categories marketing / utility / authentication / service). - Free-form messages only inside the **24-hour customer-service window**; outside it only approved templates, and only to users who opted in. - Default 80 messages/s per number; 1 message per 6 s to any single user (bursts of 45 in 6 s); messaging tiers cap unique customers per 24 h until verification / quality raise them. - WhatsApp Management API 200 calls/h per app per WABA (5,000 for active accounts). - Personal WhatsApp accounts are NOT automatable (Messaging rule: human lane).

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/messages/text-messages now redirects to https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/messages/text-messages, 'Text messages'): the WhatsApp Cloud API is business messaging - send messages and mark them read (POST /{phone_number_id}/messages); Status updates and Channels are not part of it and there are no comment, mention, post-deletion or post-analytics endpoints, so no social verb maps. WhatsApp is served in the messaging category (catalog/messaging/whatsapp.json).
